qasar: Qasar — Qasar, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]

ügülerün: ügüle- — to speak, to say; converb -rün, 'saying' [說]
ba: ba — and, both (conjunction) [并] · also 'we', first-person plural pronoun (Ming 俺, against bida 咱), standing at the head of its clause or after the verb
kēġesü: keġe- — to say; conditional -sü, 'if one says' (verb, conditional; written kēġesü) [說了]
aqa-nar: aqa-nar — elder brothers (aqa + plural -nar, back-vowel form) [兄 每]
deġü-ner: deġü-ner — younger brothers (deġü + plural -ner, front-vowel form) [弟 每]

keġebi: keġe- — to say; past -bi, 'said' (verb, past tense) [說了]

ülü: ülü — not (negates present or converb forms) [不] · also before participles (ülü boluqui, ülü ögteküi), 'not'

oγ̇orču: oγ̇or- — to throw, toss, fling (Ming 丢; stem uncertain); converb -čü, 'throwing' (verb, converb) [丢著︀]
γarču: γar- — to go out; converb -ču, 'going out' (verb, converb) [出着]

üžeġed: üže- — to see; converb -ġed, 'having seen' (verb, converb, front-vowel form) [見了]
ken-e: ken-e — by or to whoever (ken 'who' + dative-locative -e, front-vowel form) [任誰]
aburan: abura- — to repay, requite (Ming 報); converb -n, 'repaying' (verb, converb) [報]
nama-ji: nama-ji — me, as object (bi, stem nama-, + accusative -ji after a vowel) [我行]
min-u: min-u — my, of me (bi, genitive stem min-, + -u, set after its noun) [我的]
keġeġed: keġe- — to say; converb -ġed, 'having said' (verb, converb) [說了]
čirai: čirai — face, countenance (noun; Ming 顏色 'colour of the face') [顏色]
uqažu: uqa- — to understand, perceive, find out; converb -žu (verb, converb) [覺着]
γarurun: γar- — to go out; converb of time -urun, 'when going out' (verb, converb) [出時]

nodun: nodun — blood clot (noun; Ming 血塊) [血塊]
hadqun: hadqu- — to grip, clutch (Ming 握; perhaps the adqu- of §63); converb -n, 'gripping' (verb, converb) [握著︀]
šinqor: šinqor — gyrfalcon, a hunting falcon (noun; Ming 海靑) [海︀靑]
jadažu: jada- — to be in want, to lack; converb -žu (verb, converb) [窮乏着]
idekü: ide- — to eat; participle -kü, 'what is to be eaten' (verb, participle) [喫的]

tarγutai-kiriltuγ: Tarγutai-Kiriltuγ — Tarqutai-Kiriltuq, a man's name (personal name, one two-part name) [人名]
uduridču: uduri- — to lead, guide; converb -dču, 'leading' (verb, converb; a form of -žu, the d is unexplained) [引着]

qačiγ̇un: Qačiγ̇un — Qachi'un, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]
temüge: Temüge — Temüge, a son's name (personal name) [(兒)名]

ire: ire- — to come (bare stem, imperative: 'come!') (verb, imperative) [來]
tan-u: tan-u — your (plural) (ta, stem tan-, + genitive -u) [您的]
hüldežü: hülde- — to chase, overtake (stem inferred from the Ming 趕); converb -žü, 'chasing' (verb, converb) [趕了]
